status: in-progress: G0 done (self-assessed); the money and goods of the economy and the region's geography are built and tested; there is no screen, no scene and no playable game

gates.requirement: Repository discovery and ownership confirmed; actual seven locales, renderer, deployment, source rights inventoried
gates.evidence: ADRs, baseline, checkpoint, source gaps
gates.evidenceSoFar: The discovery report (docs/gaming/granada/g0-discovery.md): what exists and is reused, ownership, the museum's 25 pinned records for Granada with their review state, the claims the game would make and what supports each, the three images read against the data, G0 to G8 mapped onto M0 to M11, and what waits for the founder. Decisions G-0009 and G-0010. Baseline: the existing renderer's measurements on one machine; no Granada scene exists to measure. Limits: the museum was searched by name and by words in three prose files, not through the whole graph; no source outside the repository was read. The evidence is the author's own and no independent reader has checked it.

gates.requirement: First-time player completes water → harvest → trade → construction → quest → save loop
gates.evidence: Unassisted browser recording, E2E, player observations

gates.requirement: Deterministic fixed-step simulation and replay across frame rates and reload
gates.evidence: Seeded hashes and replay fixture
gates.evidenceSoFar: Commands only: the same commands give the same state and the same fingerprint, and different commands a different one (economy.gtest.ts, 'random play'); docs/gaming/evidence/granada/g0/economy-fuzz.json records a digest of all 300 end states. Not done: a fixed-step clock, independence from frame rate, replay after reload. There is no clock and no screen yet.

gates.requirement: Money, inventories and reservations reconcile, no free arbitrage, no duplicate settlement
gates.evidence: Ledger, property tests, economy fixture
gates.evidenceSoFar: The ledger reconciles after every one of 60,000 random commands over 300 random openings (docs/gaming/evidence/granada/g0/economy-fuzz.json: 24,460 accepted, 0 unsound states; contracts ended settled 436, cancelled 297, failed 236). Buying and selling at one set of prices never raised wealth across 30,000 random buy and sell commands. A retried command pays once; a cancelled or failed contract releases what it held once. Fifteen deliberate breakages of the kernel were all caught (docs/gaming/evidence/granada/g0/economy-mutations.md). Not done: prices that move, goods in transit, storage by place and kind, the journal's checkpoint.

gates.requirement: Raw olive valuation, overflow, oil conversion and contract alternatives correct
gates.evidence: Fixture arithmetic and UI assertions
gates.evidenceSoFar: The package's fixture is reproduced by tests to the unit: wheat round trip minus 80; olives 190,400 at the raw bid (not 435,200), 145,600 if only 5,200 fit, overflow 1,600; 1,360 oil worth 87,040; the Málaga contract 7,200 on paper, 2,400 better than a local sale, and minus 1,200 when the oil is bought at ask, which the kernel also shows by actually doing it; reserves 91% and 3,600 short (docs/gaming/evidence/granada/g0/tests.md). Not done: the 'UI assertions' half of the evidence. There is no screen.

gates.evidenceSoFar: Two of the five exist: markets with finite stock and finite money, and one recipe (five olives to one oil, cost carried into the product). Not started: transport, seasons, water.
